description.narrative: (Zambia): The Zambia Accessible Markets for Health (ZAM-Health) mechanism will.support Zambia's health sector by leveraging the comparative expertise and.advantages of the private sector. The mechanism will also support the GRZ health sector to deliver.and grow the market for targeted quality products and services in family.planning, HIV, maternal and child health, tuberculosis, and nutrition .in the urban and peri urban areas of Lusaka, Central, Southern and.Copperbelt Provinces. FY 2022 funds will be used for implementation of evidence-based SBC.activities to improve FP, MCH, nutrition and TB service uptake and adoption of.healthy seeking behaviors; facilitation of high quality RMNCAH-N services in.the private sector, including capacity building of service providers; commence.the scale down of socially marketed condoms; strengthen partnerships with.commercial suppliers of priority products to increase availability; work with Government of the Republic of Zambia.counterparts to strengthen the policy environment for the private sector. Under USAID's Country Development Cooperation.Strategy, the mechanism will support Development Objective 3: Capacity of.Zambia's Government, Citizens and Private Sector Increased to Improve Health.Outcomes and Meet Critical Needs of Vulnerable Populations. . .
